title: Assessment and Waiver of Missed-Appointment Fees — Appointment Scheduling
content:
## Assessment

A no-show on an **Appointment Scheduling** appointment at Riverbend Regional Health carries the visit type's no-show fee, and a late patient cancellation carries the visit type's late-cancellation fee, each assessed once per appointment and fee type.

The once-per-appointment-and-fee-type condition is judged from the system's records before a fee is assessed: the fee entries already recorded on that same appointment. An appointment that already carries an assessed no-show fee does not take a second no-show fee, and one that already carries an assessed late-cancellation fee does not take a second late-cancellation fee; a fee of the other type is a separate fee type.

## Waiver

The fee is waived, once per reason, when:

| Waiver reason | When it applies | Visit-type provision |
|---|---|---|
| Medicaid (BadgerCare Plus) member | the patient's coverage is BadgerCare Plus | Medicaid fee prohibition |
| first occurrence | it is the patient's first no-show or late cancellation in the count window | first-occurrence waiver |
| weather closure | Riverbend declared a weather closure | weather-closure waiver |
| patient hospitalized | the patient was hospitalized at the time | hospitalization waiver |
| Riverbend delay | Riverbend's delay caused the miss | — |

Medicare patients are treated as every other non-Medicaid patient, under the visit type's Medicare fee setting.

**Counting for the first occurrence.** The count is the patient's no-show appointments plus the patient's cancellations whose hours of notice were below the visit type's late-cancellation window, in the rolling window of the count-window months ending on the appointment date being decided. The no-show or late cancellation being decided is the first when the window holds no other such event.

A waiver is recorded per fee type and per reason, showing the fee type, the reason, the amount waived and the posting date.

## Statement and dispute

A fee appears on the patient statement the visit type's statement days after assessment, and may be disputed within the visit type's dispute days.

## Missed-appointment fee balance

Each appointment carries a balance of missed-appointment fees owed, in USD: assessments add to it, and payments and waivers reduce it.

## Worked cases — hypothetical figures

- *Hypothetical:* a patient without BadgerCare Plus coverage has a no-show on an appointment whose visit type carries a no-show fee of 40.00, and the count window holds no other no-show or late cancellation. The fee of 40.00 is assessed, adding 40.00 to the balance; it is the patient's first occurrence in the window, so the fee is waived for the reason first occurrence, reducing the balance by 40.00 to 0.00.
- *Hypothetical:* the same patient had a late cancellation inside the window before this no-show. The no-show is not the first occurrence, so the first-occurrence reason does not waive it; the other reasons are judged on their own conditions.
- *Hypothetical:* a Medicare patient with the same facts as the first case is treated exactly as the patient without BadgerCare Plus coverage.
